newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Genting unit spuds Muturi well.
newsitem.headline: Genting unit spuds Muturi well.

text.p: Genting Bhd said on Tuesday its wholly-owned Cairns Ltd unit spudded Nambumbi-1, an exploration well in the Muturi Concession, northwest Irian Jaya.
The Muturi block is held under a 1992 production sharing contract with Pertamina, Indonesia's state oil company, Genting said in a statement.
Cairns holds a 45 percent interest in the well, British Gas Plc's British Gas Exploration and Production Ltd has 50 percent and Indonesia's P.T. Saptapetra Wisesa holds the remaining five percent.
The Nambumbi-1 well is located about five km north of Atlantic Richfield Corp's (Arco) Vorwata 1 well and is being drilled from a man-made island 600 metres from shore.

"Depending on the results of this programme (on Nambumbi-1), further wells may be drilled in 1998," the statement said. It added that coincident with the drilling of the well, a seismic survey is being carried out on the permit.

Nambumbi-1 is the second well to be drilled by British Gas plc on behalf of the group in the Muturi concession. Mogoi Deep-1 was drilled in the north of the concession by the same partnership and was suspended in September 1996 as a gas discovery.
